title: DiagramGraphDataset
description: Schema for Diagram Dataset samples containing natural language descriptions, diagram type classifications, and structured Intermediate Representation (IR) graphs.

id.description: Unique stable identifier for the dataset sample, e.g., ARCH_0001 or FLOW_0042.

text.description: Natural language description describing the system, workflow, concept, database, or interaction.

id.description: Unique node identifier within the graph.

label.description: Human-readable label displayed on the diagram node.

type.description: Semantic node type specific to the diagram family.

attributes.description: Optional domain-specific attributes (e.g. technology, cardinality, role).

source_location.description: Optional mapping to source code line ranges for code-generated diagrams.

id.description: Unique edge identifier within the graph.

label.description: Relationship label (e.g. Yes, No, calls, depends on, 1:N).

edge_type.description: Semantic edge type specific to the diagram family.

directed.description: Whether the edge has directional semantics.

metadata.description: Optional edge metadata such as sequence order or protocol.

domain.description: Application or subject domain (e.g., e_commerce, operating_systems).

template_id.description: Template group identifier used for zero-leakage split grouping.

complexity.description: Structural complexity level of the diagram.
